title: Xebia: Why AI agents fail without the right data foundation
summary: Xebia's Global CTO Niels Zeilemaker explains that AI agents cannot succeed without proper data infrastructure; organizations must first make their data AI-ready before deploying agentic AI systems to accelerate business processes.
problem_solved: Addresses why many AI agent implementations fail due to insufficient data preparation and availability.
why_valuable: Provides strategic guidance on prioritizing data foundation over AI agent deployment, helping organizations avoid common implementation pitfalls.
